avis.texte: It definitely looks like my skin gets rejuvenated every time I use it! I mostly use it at night every other day. I do have sensitive skin, but since I have been using the Skinfix Triple Lipid-Peptide Cream my skin seems to be able to handle products much better, so I want to say that it is thanks to this cream that I can continue to use this serum without problems. Other barrier creams could also work to reduce skin sensitivity as well. Anyways, I will definitely be buying this product again and I am also interested in trying other products from Bloomeffects.

Magic in a bottle . Face looks like i had a facial next day after use . Worth the money . I use this the days following retinol . ( use retinol 1x a week ) Very happy . Im picky ans have almost every product that exist . Def a synergy effect in combo with other products like HA

Not gonna lie, its an expensive bottle. But my skin loves this so much its earned a permanent place in my routine. It has a slightly oily but watery texture that spreads beautifully. I have dehydrated but oily/combination skin that is acne/congestion prone. Even in hot, swampy humid MN summer my oily skin drinks this in and the next morning my skin looks *healthy* and that coveted glow from within, not greasy, not glass skin. Just really healthy and happy, redness reduced, hydrated, even toned skin. Each time I use it there is a slight skin tingle (no burn) I assume from all the wonderful actives. It layers very well with the rest of my routine AND a little goes a long way. Ive been ising this nearly nightly for 7 weeks and I'm not even halfway through the bottle yet. This one has earned its permanent place.

So many wonderful actives in this elegant and light serum. I appreciate that it doesn't clog pores and isn't too thick. Just finished my first bottle and am excited to see progress. My skin looks a bit more plump and even.
i'm on my third bottle, i'm 27 and love this. i have acne prone skin and this never broke me out
This is absolutely Devine and makes my skin feel absolutely nourished and amazing.
This product is fantastic! Only 3 days in and I have noticed a marked improvement in the texture of my skin.
I was originally gifted the Black Tulip Regenerative Brightening Serum and loved the way it smoothed textured and brightened my face that I was quick to repurchase when it was time to replace.
Love how this makes my skin feel ! All the products are great and never irritates my skin :)

I haven't had it for long yet, so I can't really speak to long-term results, but I have loved this from the first application. It feels so nice on the skin! I find I'm prone to skincare pilling but I can layer this in my routine and not have any issues with that. I can't wait to see how it continues to work for my skin.

I love this serum! I use this with the phase tonic and they make my skin radiant and soft and just healthy looking overall. I have only been using this a week or so but I feel like it is making a difference. My skin is less saggy and has less fine lines. I never want to be without these products.

avis.titre: Fell in love with this so quick!
avis.texte: My skin LOVES this! In just a few short days, my skin has literally been regenerated thanks to this serum. This was my first time using it and I can confidently say this will be staying in my routine consistently!
I just purchased this serum and I love it. It's very hydrating and makes my face so glowing. I love all Bloomeffects products.
It was a bit pricey, but I got some of the serums during the Ulta sale :). I gotta say, this serum really helped my dark spots.
I just love how this product feels on my face. I noticed the brightening effects on my skin and the deep hydration it gives.
I used this product for the first time yesterday and WOW! The way it felt going on and the way my skin felt after is just amazing. I cannot wait to try some of the other products.

This serum is gentle enough to use daily but powerful enough to see results within just a few weeks. It has helped fade acne marks and the fine lines around my mouth and nose. It's absolutely worth the price!
This is the best all in one serum if you're looking for it, brightens, reduces fine lines and helps heal blemishes faster, an absolute banger
Love this product. No breakouts, good for sensitive skin, INSTANT glow-- made me look tan, and i noticed onger term improvements. My skin was soft, taught, and bouncier. :)
I love the way this serum has brightened my skin, I use it morning and night and will never be without it!
First impression, LOVE! The texture is amazing, I noticed an immediate glow to my skin! Would definitely recommend!!

I've been using this product since nov 2025 everyday twice a day. My skin looks fresh and glowing. This is glass skin in a bottle and lays beautifully under makeup. It's on the higher end price wise but you won't regret buying it!

This is the first product I have tried that has dramatically helped with my hyperpigmentation, not vitamin c, not other serums. I did not even expect this as I was mainly interested in the peptides. Will continue to buy this!
I've tried a few different serums to help with some discoloration I have on my cheeks. This combined with my vitamin C in the morning has done wonders in just a few weeks on those spots.

avis.titre: Beautiful serum with effective ingredients and results!
avis.texte: Wonderful Serum! The results in terms of brightening are fabulous. Also, the lightweight texture of the serum means it can layer easily under other skincare. Also, just look at the ingredient deck. It's packed. I think the only deterrent to people purchasing would be the price. It is a little pricey.

I try to keep my skincare routine simple so I love a product that has multiple benefits. This ish is what me skin needed. My skin looks and feels incredibly soft and glowy immediately after I apply. Looking forward to seeing the long term benefits.
When I use this consistently my skin looks too good so I am gonna be very consistent with it because it is bomb.

I just love the Black Tulip Regenerative Serum. It absorbs quickly and makes my dry Colorado skin feel supple again. It isn't sticky and doesn't have a smell for the sensation girlies! The serum has all clean ingredients which I love so much that I use it every night. I would highly recommend this product for other women with aging skin like myself! Perfecto!

OMG! I have had this for about a week and have been using it every day! It is incredible! The Peptides and Centella make your skin so nourished and silky soft that I have never felt before . I feel like I am at a spa. I will have to use it more to see how it works for anti aging! I have high hopes it will !
Amazing serum. The texture is silky not sticky and leaves the skin feeling fresh and hydrated!
Face appears brighter with less redness since using this product. Will be adding to my permanent routine.
I love the texture of this and love the feel of it on my skin. Will definitely be repurchasing

I was wary of this product because I've used peptide serums in the past that caused horrible flare ups. This was incredibly gentle and did not cause any redness. It was thicker and more moisturizing than I was expecting. Bloomeffects is the only brand that does not cause rosacea or perioral dermatitis flare ups. I strayed from the brand for a while and my skin paid the price. I'll continue using this for sure!
This serum was surprisingly soothing for my sensitive skin and left it feeling supple and glowing. I was not expecting to love it as much as I do!
I'm so very happy with all the products I have bought from this brand. I will be a repeating customer

Everything about this serum is so stunning, from the packaging to the ingredients and texture. Ive been using it for over a few weeks now and I notice the brightening effects already. The serum is truly a powerhouse of all things for the skin. I'm already thinking of repurchasing in case I ever run out.
This serum is great! I love the consistency and how hydrating it feels! Great for sensitive skin!
Non irritating formula, I can see the brightness in my skin after a few uses.

This serum feels so luxe and instantly leaves my skin soft and glowy. I love the texture and aroma, it has no stickyness and the aroma is subtle but soothing. I've experienced no sensitivity and it's layered really well with my other products and under makeup. I can't wait to continue seeing how it improves my skin!

Been using this serum for six weeks. Noticed a big improvement in hydration and overall health of my face. I just ordered my second bottle on sale to make sure don't run out. At 53 I have found a facial serum to help me prevent more aggressive skin aging.

I feel like this took my skin to the next level, I take very good care of my skin and I feel like this made my skin glowy, bright, and plump. I rotate it between several different products and end up using this 2-3 times a week. I just wish it was a little bit more affordable so I took a star off.

New to using this serum, so too soon to report any noticible benefits. But I would like to add the serum is very thin with a silky texture, and soaks into the skin nicely - no sticky residue. There is a light smell when you open the bottle, nothing overwhelming or perfume like. But, the serum leaves NO scent on the skin after applying which is very nice. So far I really like using the brightening serum and glad I added it to my skincare routine.
I was influenced to try this product and it did not disappoint. It lives up to its ability to brighten, smooth, and hydrate the skin. I've since ordered several more products.
Very thin consistency, but hydrating, my skin is smooth and brightened after few weeks of use. Will repurchase
Heard a lot about the serum on tiktok so I decided to give it a try and let's just say it's pact with lots of potent ingredients. Worth a try and every penny!
Love the texture, very subtle scent, and great moisture this provides!

This serum is a little under the radar when you first start it. I think it took 2 to 4 weeks for me to notice a difference, but now it's clutch for my routine. My skin tone has evened out considerably with this serum, and I've noticed a glow and lessened fine lines. My husband also started using it, and noticed the same. 10/10
I am on my second bottle! Love it! Feels nice, works well with other products and I notice immediate brightening!
My skin looks brighter and fresher after just a few weeks. Can't wait to see what it looks like after the whole bottle. A definite repurchase.
Does not irritate my sensitive skin! Hoping for long term brightening effects and skin barrier repair but so far short term results are nice.

I've only been using this for about a week, so it's too soon to comment on the brightening or anti-aging effects. What I can say is that it's a beautiful, lightweight serum that doesn't feel sticky on the skin. I've been pairing it with the Bi-Phase Tonic, and my dry/dehydrated skin just drinks it up. I wake up with soft, hydrated skin — I'll definitely keep using it and see how it goes!
After a week of using I can already see the differences! It does not break me out and make my skin glow and hydrated!
Been using for 2 days so no immediate effects on anti-aging yet. But it is very hydrating and has been helping with flaky skin.
Beautiful packaging and easy to apply. Feels lovely on the skin.
My skin loves this serum. It's never looked brighter and more radiant.

I'm a long time Bloom Effects fan and therefore am not surprised this formula works well with my dry and sensitive skin. I have eczema and rosacea that is easily flared with new products but yet again, this BR product is hydrating and has caused zero irritation. Look forward to the long term benefits.

my face has truly been loving this serum. It's gentle enough to where I️ don't have to worry about it damaging my barrier but powerful enough to know it's going to get the job done. I️ have been noticing my skin a lot more happier since I've been using this product. Will be repurchasing asap!!!!

Love the Bloomeffects line! This is my second product from them and won't be my last. The regenerative serum is fantastic. I have noticed a reduction in discoloration and a overall skin tightness. A definite repurchase

The serum is soothing and decently hydrating. It it watery yet sticky. My skin feels stronger. My skin tone has improved. The only thing I hate is the button I have to push on the top of the dropper to draw and dispense the serum. It is so awkward to use. I guess I don't have dexterous fingers to press the top while holding the dropper. I have to press my palm into it while holding it like a claw.

This serum is great. Not only the technology and the list of ingredients, but the texture and feel are awesome. It adresses fine lines and wrinkles as well as uneven skin tone and it hydrates. Just a great all in one serum. Its amazing

avis.titre: Just what I was looking for!
avis.texte: I have been searching for this serum! This silky, lightweight serum glides on perfectly and layers well with other products. I love the sweet, floral scent. My skin already feels soft and smooth - I can't wait to see the continued benefits!! I will definitly be purchasing another bottle!

Skincare was once a chore, but not any more. I love to use this amazing product that leaves my skin feeling rejuvenated. After only 3 weeks of use, fine lines are much harder to see. I highly recommend this unique product!

I don't know if it is my imagination but I feel like this makes an immediate difference on my skin. I feel a pleasant tingling as the serum penetrates my skin. I love the light fragrance as I dab it on in the morning. It leaves my skin soft and moisturized, so much so that I have skipped my moisturizer. How is it that I've never heard of BloomEffects until Alex from Educated Mess raved about its formulation! Looking forward to trying other products in the lineup.

avis.titre: Have no clue how this is not the #1 seller of any brand ever
avis.texte: This is THAT good. The texture. The results. The ingredients. The technology of the delivery system. It's all so good this should be all over social Media every day. (And it should have 5 stars on here from anyone and everyone!!)

avis.titre: about 2 weeks in - loving it so far!
avis.texte: I have fairly sensitive skin so I have to be careful with adding in new products to my routine, but I have had no issues with this. I like how it's lightweight and absorbs fairly quickly for a serum. I feel like I may see a positive difference already, so I'm excited to continue using!

avis.titre: Brightening serum and Vitamin C Oil
avis.texte: This serum along with the vitamin C oil really helped brighten my skin and lighten some dark spots. Going back for my second bottle

Have been using this everyday twice for two weeks and gave noticed a difference in my skin! I love it as it's not sticky or oily and absorbs so good!! Pairing it with dew cream in the morning and nectar at night has made my daily routine simple! Will definitely repurchase.

Finishing my first bottle of Black Tulip Regenerative Brightening Serum, my skin feels brighter and my fine lines are less apparent. The light formula works great for layering under other products. Love the clean ingredients. I will definitely purchase again.

This serum literally has so many new and advanced ingredients along with putting them in amazing delivery systems to ensure the ingredients get where they should go. Results show quickly for a topical product. Definitely a repurchase for me.
I love the tulip serum! It has brighten my complexion and reduced my texture. It goes on silky and absorbs quickly into my skin. I would highly recommend.
It's a little sticky, even if I use a small amount. I've only been using it a couple weeks, so no big difference yet.
Honestly I am loving this serum. I have extremely sensitive dry skin. This is a dream serum for me. Super hydrating but not sticky or oily!! I will repurchase!!
My skin drinks this stuff up like no other. Leaves my face glowing, soft, and hydrated. Now a part of my daily routine forever.

avis.titre: A few drops pack a BIG punch!
avis.texte: I've been using my Regenerative Serum for only ten days. I know that this is a product that requires consistent use and time to allow it to work - but I can tell already that it's going to be a staple in my skincare lineup. I've already noticed more radiance and a smoother texture. The serum is lightweight but hydrating. I'm so eager to continue using this and see all the benefits to come. Already ordered my second bottle!
I've been using it for about a week and so far I love it! It's very hydrating and I'm hoping to see results soon!
It has reduced my fine lines and wrinkles. The dark spots on my face have lightened considerably. I love it! 🩷
Hydrates skin without feeling oily! Have used for 2 weeks and loving the results so far.

Love the light consistency of the serum, while it's still hydrating. My skin feels smooth and firmer since using it. It layers well under makeup and other products. Beautiful packaging, and great ingredients. Highly recommend!

This serum has become a staple in my routine. It has a refreshing gel-to-water consistency that absorbs quickly and feels weightless on the skin. It layers beautifully with other products and delivers an instant brightening effect. My skin feels hydrated, never sticky, and it hasn't caused any irritation—even with my sensitive skin. Over time, I've noticed a more even, radiant complexion. Highly recommend!
I have only been using this product for a very short time, but I have already noticed a brightening effect. The serum wears well under makeup, so far so good.
So far my sensitive skin has had no issues. This serum has made my skin feel very moisturized

I've been using The Black Tulip Regenerative Serum for almost 2 months and I love it so much that I just ordered another so I won't have to wait when mine runs out. It simplifies my evening routine which is so great especially when I'm tired. It combines my peptides, copper peptides, brightening, and more in one. I have noticed a significant brightening in my one pregnancy-induced dark spot which I've had for years. It's almost unnoticeable now! My skin loves this serum.

I have been using the serum for just over a month and have already purchased 2 backups! It feels so soothing and restorative when I apply it, and leaves my skin feeling plump and dewy! LOVE LOVE LOVE!

avis.titre: I AM ENJOYING THE BLACK TULIP REGENERATIVE BRIGHTENING SERUM
avis.texte: I have just recently received this Serum and appreciate that it seems to sink right into my skin when I apply it. It's too soon to see brightening, but as with all my other Bloomeffects products I feel that with consistent use it will be effective on my older skin. I do have sensitive skin and have had no issues with this Serum or any other Bloomeffects products as far as any sensitivity situations. I am pleased so far with this new Black Tulip Serum.

I just started using this product but a week in and I am noticing a difference! my skin is brighter and smoother!! Can't wait to see after extended use what my skin will look like..This is a must have!!
One month in and still loving this serum!! Its lightweight but highly moisturizing for my dry sensitive skin. I use it on my off tret nights. Love it!

I have just recently been trying this product. I have been using the Royal Tulip Nectar for many months and have found it really helpful for the texture of my skin. I am not really a user of serums ( having only used samples from various companies) so this is new for me. I'm in my mid sixties and feeling the inclination to pay more attention to my skin. I have taken a few comparison pics ( just for me ) and, while it is hard to see improvement after a few weeks, my skin does feel softer. The lines on my face are part of being my age but I'm sure I can improve this with care. The Black Tulip Regenerative Brightening Serum feels nice to apply and in conjunction with the other products I am feeling happy with the initial results.

I couldn't wait to purchase this serum when it first came out and I was not disappointed. I've been using this for over a month now and it is by far my favorite serum. Even with my extremely sensitive skin, I have had zero irritation, and I've even been able to use it around my eyes. I love the texture, it layers well with just about everything, and I can't believe how radiant my skin is now. Definitely noticed a difference in my under-eye texture/fine lines and how well my concealer is sitting as well. This is seriously just *chef's kiss for me and I have already repurchased. This will be a new staple for me.

avis.titre: Hydrating and ok for sensitized skin
avis.texte: I am late 30s, dry sensitive skin. My skin has also been pretty sensitized lately by tret. This is surprisingly nourishing and hydrating. I use with educated mess freeze frame over it and love the feeling. My skin feels so hydrated. I look forward to continue to use and now will purchase more on my wishlist from Bloom Effects!

So far, I'm enjoying the way this feels and the dewy/hydrating effect it has on my skin. Looking forward to seeing further results after a few more weeks of use! Initial impression is that this is a great serum to incorporate in to my routine. The bottle is also really nice, only slight piece of feedback would be the dropper in the lid is a little hard to manage. Overall, loving it!

As part of the Gloss Angeles Confidential testers, I tested this project for about 1 month and I LOVED it! The product did deliver on its claims. I had a few surprising breakouts from my makeup brushes that had left a few marks. Within the testing month, the scars faded by about 90%. Additionally, just in the first few days of using the serum, I felt that the serum gave me a specific glow. The viscosity of the serum lead to a great experience in being able to massage the serum into my skin. I think this serum is an all in one option! You honestly don't need any other actives in your skincare routine if you would use. I highly recommend and would buy again. Especially for my mom!

At 41, with sensitive skin prone to rosacea breakouts, I'm constantly searching for products that will make my skin look fresh and minimize fine lines without triggering a breakout. After 10 days of use, I'm seeing a noticiable difference in my overall complexion… the glow is real - and the lines around my nose aren't as prominent. No flare ups either as this product is gentle but effective. YAY!

avis.titre: My skin was not a fan
avis.texte: I received this item as a gift for an honest review from GlossAngeles. Sadly my skin was not a fan of this product- within a week of use my skin broke out terribly in small white like blister pimples. I am in my (almost) mid 40s with a great skin texture and tone- love trying new product. I continued use for another week thinking it was a purge but they continued. Beautiful jar but not the product for my skin.

avis.titre: Glowy Skin & Bouncy skin at 41 years old!
avis.texte: Just wrapped up my bottle of this serum and honestly, my skin soaked it up and loved every drop. I'm 41 and always searching for products that help me maintain that healthy glow, and this one really impressed me. My skin looked brighter and felt bouncier. Best part? No stickiness. That's huge for me, especially living somewhere that's hot and crazy humid basically all year round. What stood out the most was how light it felt going on. It didn't sit heavy or greasy, just absorbed beautifully. Over time, I noticed my skin texture evening out, looking smoother, and even those little forehead lines (my one trouble spot) seemed softer by the 4th week of testing this serum. Big thanks to Gloss Angeles Confidential for letting me try this.

I'm obsessed with this serum! I've built up to daily use and haven't had any skin sensitivities to it. I feel like it's helping my hyperpigmentation and giving me a glow. I find applying to damp skin really helps it absorb into my skin. I pair it with the vitamin c facial oil and have been loving the results!
Hydration in a bottle. Your face will thank you for this product! I have visibly glowy and firmer looking skin after a night with this serum on. Efficacy at such a great price point - obsessed!

avis.titre: Enjoying this added item to my routine
avis.texte: I was interested in trying this Serum for the actives and multipeptides. I have older skin and a couple of small spots of hyperpigmentation I would like to lighten. I just received it and am enjoying the Serum so far. It soaks in and makes my skin so moisturized. Give it a try!
I have very sensitive and acne prone skin. My skin tolerated this serum just fine. Love the benefits this offers. My skin is bright and healthy.

After using this serum for some time I can appreciate that it's a beautiful formula, while it might not exactly work for me!! I have very sensitive skin, and I got some small white pimples after using this. However I think that's just my skin, and my overall experience with the serum otherwise was very positive. The bottle is chic and feels expensive, the serum is light and glides on well over a toner or a light spritz of water. I was gifted this serum through Gloss Angeles, so I will be passing it to a friend to try since it's not for me!
I've been using this twice a day and my skin is brighter! I love all of their products 💗
I was gifted this serum from a family member, and so far I love it! I'm still using it every other day and building up to daily use. I'm excited that it's giving me a glow already!

I've been using the Bloomeffects Black Tulip Regenerative Brightening Serum for just over a month and I'm genuinely impressed. My skin looks and feels smoother and firmer, and a few of my stubborn hyperpigmentation spots have visibly faded. The texture is lightweight and silky, and it layers seamlessly with the rest of my skincare. My complexion looks brighter, more even, and overall healthier. The packaging is also beautiful, which makes the whole experience feel extra luxe. Definitely worth it. I'll be repurchasing.
I love any product with exosomes but this one is especially effective. Go to bed with dull skin and wake up with glowing, bouncy skin
Spot on product. I spend a tonne of time in the sun, has helped my skin so much.

This was my first time trying Bloomeffects. I was gifted the product through Gloss Angeles Confidential. When first applied it has a nice lightweight feel and it absorbs quickly. After several weeks of use I didn't notice any drastic difference in appearance when it came to evening skintone but my skin did look smooth. Based on the science/technology behind the product and price point, I would have liked to see more noticible results but I also don't have any deep wrinkles or intense hyperpigmentation. Overall it's a nice serum though.

I've purchased most of the range over the years, with my favorites being the Nectar, Vitamin C Oil and the sunscreen stick, but I think this serum might be the best of all! Really feels like it's working without being too strong or harsh on my skin. My skin is looking a lot brighter after 2 weeks of use. Highly recommend!

I got rid of half the products on my shelf for this super serum. My skin feels tighter, brighter and my skin tone is so even only after a month of using it! It doesn't leave any oil or stickiness on my skin like lots of other products do and I will be recommending this to anyone who will listen.
For some reason my skin and Vitamin C get into fights. This has been an absolutely amazing alternative and then some! This in the AM and Tret in the evening have been a phenomenal combo!
I love all of my Bloom Effects products including this one. I've been using it morning and night like suggested and my skin looks and feels amazing!

I used this product as my nighttime serum before my heavier night moisturizer and after 3 weeks I noticed a significant difference! My skin texture was smoother, more even and plump plus my hyperpigmentation from sun damage was becoming much less visible. I am so excited to keep using this product - it's a true staple in my routine now because the results speak for themselves!!

My skin was looking as tired as I felt—dull, uneven, and with hormonal pigmentation . This serum is the skincare solution for busy and tired mums. It's like eight hours of sleep and a facial… without either actually happening.

I've been using this serum for a couple of weeks so it's too early to see results, but I love the texture of it and how it feel on the skin. The ingredients are phenomenal as per usual for Bloomeffects. I love that it can replace my copper peptides and anti-hyperpigmentation serum and peptide serum - which actually makes the price so worth it. They say not to use it with retinol because of potential sensitivities but my skin is very resilient to retinol and I tried both together before I noticed this recommendation and had no issues. YMMV, but that was my experience.
Really loving the texture and absorption of this serum. Wears great under makeup every morning and gives a lovely bounce to my skin. Time will tell on the brightening effects but love it so far!

avis.titre: Refreshing blend of advanced tech and botanicals
avis.texte: I've seen plenty of buzz around BE's SPF but Alex of EducatedMess's passion for the brand tipped the scale and I just had to try the Black Tulip Regenerative Brightening Serum. I've been using it for about a month and my skin is just so happy! Most of the benefits will take some more time to see but my routine is already pretty stacked with actives and I still see subtle improvements in just this short time to the brightness of my melasma. Will 100% be repurchasing! The water-light texture sealed this as a favorite so I can layer it with other serums and not feel overloaded even as the days get hotter. Love it!!

I'm enjoying this serum —it totally lives up to Bloomeffects' natural Dutch beauty roots. It sinks in fast, no sticky feeling at all, and works great under my moisturizer and makeup. Plus, no irritation whatsoever, which is a big deal for my sensitive, menopausal skin!
